verdict.rationale: Meilisearch ships a native MCP server at POST /mcp. Its docs say that, through any MCP-compatible AI client, users can create indexes, add documents, configure settings (ranking rules, searchable attributes, faceting) and run searches using natural-language prompts. That covers operating the product, not just querying it. Natural-language operation depends on an external AI client, and the only evidence is vendor claims. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language console that needs no third-party AI client, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP natural-language operation works as claimed.
